---
title: "Cicero, *Pro Archia*"
---



This web site is planned to include a readable text of Cicero's *Pro Archia* with a variety of visualizations presenting syntactic analysis of the text.

## How it works

The `arsgrammatica` Python package analyzes the syntax of Latin texts. This project's github repository includes analyses of *Pro Archia* that were automatically generated by an early version of `arsgrammatica`, and  interactive Marimo notebooks to format and visualize the results. These notebooks can be exported to web apps (WASM format), and hosted on [http://shot.holycross.edu](http://shot.holycross.edu).


## Experiment

Here's a [first experiment](https://shot.holycross.edu/readers/proarchia/) to test some of the planned functionality. 

::: {.callout-caution}
## Limitations

The experimental app analyzes only a selection from the *Pro Archia*, using a beta version of `arsgrammatica`. The analyses have not been verified and include errors.

:::
